title: Communication-Efficient Learning of Deep Networks from Decentralized Data
task: Image/language benchmarks; simulated device partitions, including non-IID and unbalanced data; no geographic forecast domain.
mechanism: Local SGD followed by sample-count weighted parameter averaging; one shared global model.
personalization: No separate personal objective in this algorithm.
climate: No climate inputs or physical graph in this algorithm.
study_region: No geographic forecast region; benchmark client partitions
tuning: Client fraction C, local epochs E, minibatch B and learning rate are studied; original experiments include extensive configuration trials.
privacy: Raw records remain local; the paper explicitly leaves stronger DP/secure-computation guarantees to additional mechanisms.
difference: CAA adds monitor-loss and ENSO/IOD relevance terms and adaptive proximal regularization; it must still aggregate actual parameters to use the FL label.
locators: Sections 1–3; Algorithm 1; privacy discussion and final discussion; PDF pp. 1–5, 8.

title: Federated Optimization in Heterogeneous Networks
task: Synthetic and image/language client benchmarks; statistical and systems heterogeneity; no geographic forecast domain.
mechanism: Local objective F_k(w)+mu/2 ||w−w_t||²; permits inexact/variable local work and aggregates a global model.
personalization: The original global algorithm does not introduce Ditto-style personal models.
climate: No climate inputs in this algorithm.
study_region: No geographic forecast region; benchmark client partitions
tuning: Learning rate selected with FedAvg and shared; mu candidates {0.001,0.01,0.1,1}; loss-based adaptive-mu heuristic also discussed.
privacy: Privacy is explicitly outside the paper’s focus; DP and secure multiparty techniques may be combined with it.
difference: CAA uses bounded climate-conditioned mu and non-count aggregation. Retained last-local FedProx outputs are benchmark diagnostics, not a newly defined original FedProx objective.
version: Original MLSys proceedings PDF with appendices
locators: Footnote 1; Sections 3, 5.1, 5.3.2; Appendix C.2; PDF pp. 1, 3–4, 8, 10, 18.

title: Ditto: Fair and Robust Federated Learning Through Personalization
task: Vision/language client benchmarks; fairness and robustness to attacks; no physical forecast domain.
mechanism: Separate global optimization and personal objective F_k(v_k)+lambda/2 ||v_k−w*||²; personal states persist.
personalization: Explicit client model alongside the global model.
climate: No climate conditioning in this algorithm.
study_region: No geographic forecast region; benchmark client partitions
tuning: Lambda selected on each client’s random local validation split; candidate sets depend on attack strength. This differs from the revised shared chronological sweep.
privacy: Personalization does not add model-message traffic to the chosen global solver; any DP guarantee depends on the solver’s added noise/accounting.
difference: CAA’s retained local models and adaptive proximal updates are not identical to Ditto’s independent personal optimization stream.
locators: Sections 3–4; Algorithm 1; privacy bullet; PDF pp. 3–5, 7.

title: Personalized Cross-Silo Federated Learning on Non-IID Data
task: Non-IID image-classification silos; no physical forecast domain.
mechanism: Server keeps a personal cloud model for each client; attentive convex message mixing depends on model-parameter distance. Heuristic variant uses cosine similarity.
personalization: Pairwise personalized cloud/local models rather than one global model.
climate: No physical climate descriptors in this algorithm.
graph: Implicit adaptive client collaboration from parameter similarity.
study_region: No geographic forecast region; benchmark client partitions
tuning: Attention scale, self-attention weight and regularization matter; conference text refers detailed settings to external Appendix C, so a complete grid is not verified here.
privacy: Server sees client parameters; raw-data locality is stated, but this is not a certified DP claim.
difference: The revised graph branch fixes training-derived physical descriptors before fitting; it is not FedAMP’s iterative parameter-similarity rule.
version: Original AAAI proceedings PDF; external appendix not separately retrieved
locators: Sections 3–4, Eq. (5)–(7), Section 6 Eq. (8), Section 7 appendix pointer; PDF pp. 2–6.

title: FedALA: Adaptive Local Aggregation for Personalized Federated Learning
task: Image and text classification under heterogeneous client partitions; no physical forecast domain.
mechanism: Locally learns element-wise weights mixing downloaded global and old local parameters for initialization; then ordinary local training and upload.
personalization: Client-specific local aggregation weights, chiefly upper layers.
climate: No physical climate conditioning in this algorithm.
study_region: No geographic forecast region; benchmark client partitions
tuning: ALA local-data fraction s and layer range p studied; selected s=80%, p=1 to trade computation against performance; five repeats.
privacy: One global-model download and one local-model upload per iteration; extra local computation, not an automatic DP guarantee.
difference: CAA uses client-level server aggregation scalars and climate-dependent proximal strength, not element-wise learned local parameter mixing.
locators: Method Eq. (4)–(6), Algorithm 1, Effects of s/p, communication Table 3; PDF pp. 3–6.

title: Personalized Federated Learning with First Order Model Optimization
task: Image classification; local and shifted client target distributions; no physical forecast domain.
mechanism: Client evaluates downloaded peer models on local validation data; weights improve local loss relative to model distance, with negative weights removed.
personalization: Distinct weighted parameter mixture per client.
climate: No physical climate inputs in this algorithm.
graph: Learned client relevance, no prescribed physical graph.
explainability: Weight visualizations, not SHAP feature attribution.
study_region: No geographic forecast region; benchmark client partitions
tuning: Model-download count, exploration, and validation fraction matter; appendix default train/validation 80/20 and tests multiple fractions.
privacy: Multiple peer models increase download bandwidth; optional DP-SGD experiments report epsilon/delta. Those guarantees belong to the DP variant.
difference: The revised central-control router mixes predictions after fitting; it is not FedFomo’s iterative parameter personalization.
version: Author arXiv v4, 26 March 2021; header identifies ICLR 2021
locators: Sections 3.1–3.2, Eq. (3), bandwidth discussion; Appendices A.4, A.6–A.7; PDF pp. 3–5, 15–17.

title: Personalized federated learning for improving radar based precipitation nowcasting on heterogeneous areas
task: Next-five-minute VIL radar-image regression from three prior images; one Czech/Slovak-border radar, four artificial 50×50 km quadrants from a 100×100 km crop, 1 km pixels; April–July 2016.
mechanism: FedAvg training followed by client-specific local fine-tuning of a nine-layer 2D CNN.
personalization: Distinct fine-tuned client parameters; a common fine-tuning budget does not mean uniform final models.
climate: Radar VIL; teleconnection conditioning not reported.
graph: No client-similarity graph reported as a method.
tuning: 100-epoch total budget; round/fine-tuning sweep includes test-set curves; selected 9×10 FL epochs plus 10 local epochs.
privacy: Raw radar images remain local in the simulated federation; formal DP/secure aggregation not established by this mechanism.
difference: Different target, cadence and personalization mechanism: revised CAA adds climate-conditioned aggregation/proximal updates, not just post-FL fine-tuning.
version: Author arXiv v1 accepted manuscript; publisher HTML independently checked for mechanism/data/tuning
locators: Sections 3–5, Algorithm 1, architecture Table 3, Appendix B; author PDF pp. 6–15, 25 onward; publisher Sections 3–5.

title: Prompt Federated Learning for Weather Forecasting: Toward Foundation Models on Meteorological Data
task: NASA multivariate weather series: precipitation, temperature and upwelling-solar datasets with 88/525/238 devices; P=12 past and Q=15 future steps. Exact geographic bounds not established here.
mechanism: Frozen Transformer plus temporal/spatial prompts; prompt graph generation followed by GAT/GCN aggregation and global prompt averaging.
personalization: Local prompt adaptation with graph collaboration.
climate: Weather-variable histories; ENSO/IOD conditioning not reported.
graph: Dynamic graph built from learned prompt relationships.
explainability: SHAP not reported as a method.
study_region: NASA datasets; exact geographic bounds not verified
tuning: 60/20/20 split; Adam 0.001, batch 128, 20 rounds, alpha=0.5 and early stopping reported.
privacy: Prompt exchange and raw-data locality; these do not themselves certify DP.
difference: Original already uses graph aggregation. Revised graph uses static fit-only climatology/covariance/teleconnection descriptors instead of learned prompt relationships.
locators: Sections 4.2–4.3, Eq. (11)–(12), Algorithm 1, Section 5.1; PDF pp. 3–5 (3534–3536).

title: Federated Prompt Learning for Weather Foundation Models on Devices
task: NASA device-series weather forecasting; 12-hour history to 12-hour future; univariate and multivariate tasks, same 88/525/238 source device counts. Exact geographic bounds not established here.
mechanism: Frozen foundation model with temporal, inter-variable and spatial prompts; global and personal prompt communication.
personalization: Explicit personalized prompts and multi-level collaboration.
climate: Weather histories; ENSO/IOD mechanism not reported.
graph: Static Haversine geography and dynamic prompt-similarity graphs.
explainability: SHAP not reported as a method.
study_region: NASA datasets; exact geographic bounds not verified
tuning: Prompt steps {1,2,3,4,6,12} and subgraph steps {1,2,4,6,8,10} studied; main and sensitivity budgets differ.
privacy: Authors state a prompt privacy theorem and test a DP-noise variant; a complete epsilon/delta accountant is not established from the conference text inspected here.
difference: Graph personalization and geography predate this revision; distinguish fixed training-only physical/teleconnection descriptors, not graph existence.
version: Original IJCAI proceedings PDF; external full appendices not separately retrieved
locators: Sections 4.1–4.3, Eq. (7)–(9), Algorithm 2, privacy Theorem 2, Section 6/Table 5–7; PDF pp. 3–7.

title: A distributed approach to meteorological predictions: addressing data imbalance in precipitation prediction models through federated learning and GANs
task: Rain/no-rain classification from Australian tabular meteorology, 13 inputs, 140672 records, nine regional silos; 2007–2017 observations.
mechanism: Shared neural classifier trained through local updates/server aggregation; SMOTE and GAN variants augment imbalanced local data.
personalization: No separate personal objective reported in the inspected preprint.
climate: Local weather variables; teleconnection conditioning not reported.
graph: No similarity graph reported as a method.
explainability: No SHAP method reported in the inspected version.
tuning: 70/10/20 train/validation/test split; SGD 0.001, momentum 0.9, batch 64, 30 epochs and 10 aggregation rounds reported.
privacy: Preprint claims DP from a Gaussian hidden layer (sd 0.01); no epsilon/delta accountant verified. Noise insertion alone must not be equated with a proven guarantee.
difference: Binary precipitation occurrence and class augmentation are not monthly rainfall-amount regression or climate-weighted FL.
version: Published abstract/metadata verified; mechanism inspected in author Research Square v1 (2023), DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-3463206/v1; final full text inaccessible
locators: Author preprint Introduction/Table 1, Sections 2.1–2.2/Listing 1, Figure 4; PDF pp. 2–4, 6–7, 11–12.
